newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas falls over winter, only three deals done.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas falls over winter, only three deals done.

text.p: Prices on the IPE natural gas futures contract fell on Monday afternoon after a blank session in the morning, but the volume of trade remained thin with only three separate trades done.
November traded 45 lots in two deals at 12.50 pence a therm and 12.45 pence respectively, after settling at 12.515 pence on Friday evening.
And December traded one 25 lot deal at 13.90 pence a therm, down 0.015 pence from Friday's settlement.

There were no bids or offers on front month August at the end of the session. And July 1998, the new final month following the roll of July 97 at the end of last week, was also without bids and offers and has yet to trade.
The 70 lots traded compared with 55 lots traded last Monday and no trades at all on Monday 16 June.
